svg.title: Nares Strait — von Mises stress
svg.desc: The same Nares Strait sea-ice frame, coloured by cell-mean von Mises stress in kilopascals using Viridis, matching the research page beam illustration. The linear scale runs from 0 to 60 kPa, with values above 60 kPa shown in yellow and indicated by the 60-plus legend label. A thicker white coastline is superposed in the same geographic coordinates. Deformation is not exaggerated.

g.font-family: Inter Variable, Inter, -apple-system, system-ui, Arial, sans-serif
